messages:
maria: CI flipped red on nightly h100 run after merge abc1234. Job: nightly/h100-e2e-quant. Logs show XID messages and OOM in quantized-runner test. Suspect driver/CUDA mismatch. Anyone oncall?

ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/eng-ml/pipelines/nightly/jobs/4321 (exit 1)

kevin: ping @eng-ml — can someone triage? marking as flaky-blocker.

jun: I can take a look. Which agent and image?

maria: agent: h100-rt-12-3-07, image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-cuda12.2.0, commit: abc1234. Test hit `RuntimeError: CUDA driver version is insufficient` in logs then later `RuntimeError: out of memory` for the same run. dmesg snippets: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1e): 79`

jun: that Xid 79 often points at kernel/user ABI mismatch or bad driver. Can infra run `nvidia-smi -a` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` on that host?

kevin: I've kicked a rerun with two changes: pinned image to redwood/runtime:2026-02-cuda12.1.0 and set env FORCE_DRIVER_CHECK=1. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/…/rerun/9876

ops-bot: Rerun queued on h100-rt-12-1 (job 9876).

jun: looking at the failing logs from the original run: `libcuda: version mismatch (12.2 headers vs 12.1 runtime)` and NVML failed to init. Also saw `CUBLAS_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED` near the OOM. That suggests early driver init problem rather than just memory pressure.

maria: if it's a host driver bump, it will affect other jobs. Do we have any recent infra driver upgrades?

kevin: infra pushed driver 535.86 last week to the h100 fleet. Some nodes are on 535.54 still. Might be a split.

jun: plan: 1) bisect the nightly commit range 10..14 to see if changes in runtime triggered a different kernel call path; 2) repro on a spare node with the exact image+host driver combo; 3) if repro, capture `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, and a minimal repro loop. I'm starting bisect runs now (small batch)

maria: thanks. also please try a run with `--no-cudnn` or reduced batch size to rule out allocation pattern changes.

jun: good call. I'll run a minimal invocation: `python -m tests.repro --model small --steps 50 --cuda-device 0` and iterate. Adding the `--save-kv-cache` flag since the failure happened during kv cache growth.

kevin: temporary unblock: i opened PR #2345 that skips the specific flaky quantized test on h100 agents until we have a root cause. Not ideal but buys time for other nightly jobs.

maria: please mark that as emergency temporary skip and include failure ticket reference so we don't lose it.

jun: bisect update: the first 3 candidates show failure with same Xid 79 on hosts with driver 535.86 when using cuda12.2 image. The cuda12.1 image ran clean on the same host. Going to run with the older driver image swapped back on a newly repro'd host to confirm.

kevin: infra is reproing with driver downgrade on a spare h100 now, will post the host link.

jun: if downgrade fixes it, this is likely a host driver incompat with our runtime kernel modules or kernel ABI. Could be our custom allocator touching a new code path that exposes the regression. I'll collect core logs and file an issue.

maria: opening the incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-789, tagging eng-ml, eng-infra, priority:high. Put bisect output and dmesg in the ticket.

kevin: small note — i saw `kernel: watchdog: GPU hung` in one log, different from pure driver mismatch. Might be memory corruption.

jun: noted. collecting `valgrind`-style traces is noisy on GPUs but I'll dump allocator stats and run with ASAN for CPU-side checks.

maria: ETA?

jun: ~2 hours to finish full bisect and attach logs. Will update here with a clear repro or a confirmation that infra downgrade fixes the fleet.

kevin: thanks all. If bisect points to a runtime/regression, i'll call for a rollback of the runtime image until we have a fix.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks jun — assign to you.

jun: will post the minimal repro and the job links when done.

kevin: FYI added a short checklist in the ticket: `nvidia-smi -a`, `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`, `dmesg | grep NVRM`, and `curl $CI_JOB_LOG`. Saves time for followups.

maria: ok closing loop for now, keep updates in INF-789 and drop logs here if anything new.
